headline: JSA advises BlissClub on ₹160 crore Series B fundraise led by Singularity AMC
sum: <cite index="2-1,2-2">Bengaluru-based D2C athleisure brand BlissClub raised ₹160 crore in a Series B funding round led by Singularity AMC</cite>. <cite index="2-4">The firm plans to utilise the fresh capital to support category expansion, scale up its offline retail presence, strengthen product development, and hire for its next stage of growth</cite>.
implication: <cite index="20-3,20-6">First time a new institutional investor entered BlissClub's cap table since 2022, with both existing backers Elevation Capital and Eight Roads Ventures choosing to return rather than exit, signalling strong founder-investor alignment in growth-stage consumer brands</cite>.
detail: <cite index="4-1">BlissClub closed the ₹160 crore ($16.8 million) Series B funding round on August 7, 2026, led by Singularity AMC, with existing investors Elevation Capital and Eight Roads Ventures doubling their positions</cite>. <cite index="4-3">The round drew significant personal capital commitment from founder Minu Margeret and her partner Vidit Aatrey, co-founder and CEO of social commerce platform Meesho</cite>. <cite index="4-5,4-7">In fiscal year ended March 2025, BlissClub's operating revenue rose 51% to ₹131.5 crore from ₹87 crore the year before, while total losses fell 54.5% to ₹20 crore from ₹44 crore, strengthening the company's case for an expensive retail expansion bet</cite>.

structure.novel: Founder and CEO Minu Margeret's significant personal co-investment alongside Vidit Aatrey signals non-dilutive capital infusion model and founder-investor alignment; first institutional lead (Singularity AMC) entry to cap table since 2022 while existing VCs doubled down indicates strong risk/return conviction. Omnichannel pivot (D2C to retail-heavy) marks sectoral structuring shift for Indian consumer VCs.

triggers.note: Equity issuance over stated cap requires ordinary shareholder resolution; Board pre-approval of terms, consideration, and investor identity mandatory.
Singularity AMC FDI eligibility and pricing benchmarking; automatic route for e-commerce, but jurisdiction of beneficial owner must clear Press Note 3 (2020) if border-country investor.
Non-resident investor's entry valuation must be certified by recognized valuation firm; failure to certify exposes transferor to angel tax levy (30% + surcharge on excess valuation).
If Singularity AMC is SEBI-regulated Category III AIF, offer document and investor suitability criteria apply; transaction-level disclosures in AIF annual filings.
If Singularity AMC foreign-domiciled, pricing must comply with RBI Liberalized Remittance Scheme (if applicable) and No Objection Certificate (NOC) may be required for repatriation.
